summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the AI hyperscaler demand node toward less-obvious US-listed suppliers tied to physical deployment chokepoints: electrical/mechanical construction labor, medium-voltage switchgear, liquid cooling, rack-level power/cooling, and AI data-center hardware manufacturing. These are research candidates only, not recommendations. The strongest direct bottleneck signals in this pass are rising data-center backlog/orders at specialty contractors and switchgear vendors, plus explicit vendor moves into liquid cooling for high-density AI racks.
